decisions.reason: The connector pinout uses the unchanged signal names SCL0 and 5V_EN; remapping those signals at the ESP32 does not change the interboard connector definition.
The GPIO remapping does not change the separate interboard power connector, its type, or its pin-order rule.
Moving SCL0 to GPIO38 does not change the retained I2C speed, pull-ups, series resistors, or cable-length constraints.
The source changes 5V_EN, SCL0, and SPI MOSI assignments but does not change the USB D+ and D- requirement.
The candidate already has a complete same-message MODIFY changing enable_gpio from GPIO3 to GPIO5; no additional update or removal is required.
The ESP32-S3 pin remapping does not alter the three-board architecture or the defined roles of the main and sensor boards.
The GPIO changes do not alter the standalone USB power regulator, activation condition, powered rail, loads, or source selection.
The candidate already has a complete same-message MODIFY updating LED rail shutdown control from GPIO3 to GPIO5; no additional change is needed.
The MCU GPIO remapping does not change the sensor board's role as a connector hub.
Assigning SPI MOSI to GPIO26 potentially conflicts with the current GPIO26 touch-wake assignment, but the source does not specify whether touch wake is remapped, removed, or safely shares the pin.
The source does not change the LED array board or its required count of eight addressable LEDs.
The GPIO remapping does not change the AXP2101 power-management role, system rails, or battery power path.
